title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/campaign/magic.yaml
description: The magic catalogue: how a spell is cast, which lore each wizard uses and the spells of every lore. It is the canonical source of lores and spells — the hireling profiles reference them by `lore.*` and `spell.*` id instead of restating them, and a wizard never carries his own copy of a spell list.

lores.description: The lores, each with its spells.

pending_lores.description: Lores known to exist whose spells are not transcribed yet. An empty list is the declared convention for `nothing pending`, so a pending lore is recorded as data instead of being silently missing.

effect_ids.description: Effects of this catalogue a warband's own special rules may modify.

casting_rules.description: The rules shared by every caster: how a spell is cast, how damage is resolved and how a wizard starts.

damage.description: How damage from a spell is resolved.

starting_spells.description: How many spells a wizard starts with and how the first one is determined.

assignments.description: Which lore each wizard of each warband uses. The assignment is editorial knowledge: it is not inferred from a profile name.

assignment.description: One wizard-to-lore assignment. A band wizard is identified by the pair (`band`, `profile_id`); a hireling wizard belongs to no warband, so `band` is `null` and `profile_id` alone names him.

wizard.description: Editorial key of the assignment (`<band-slug>-<wizard-slug>`), kept stable so a row can be discussed in review.

band.description: Warband the wizard belongs to, or `null` when he is a hireling: a Hired Sword or a Dramatis Persona is hired by any warband, so only his `profile_id` identifies him.

lore.description: Lore the wizard casts from: a `lore.*` id of this document.

note.description: Editorial note about the lore: who may use it, where it comes from, anything the spell rows do not say.

spell.description: One spell. `roll` is the D6 a wizard rolls to determine it, not part of its id.

roll.description: The D6 result that determines the spell, as printed: `0` for a spell of an open-ended row, `1`–`6` otherwise.

difficulty.description: Casting difficulty: the value 2D6 must reach, or `auto` for a spell that is not rolled for.
